resources.string: This is not set up for %1$s yet. English and Spanish work.
The speech model is missing. Add it in Settings under Voice typing.
The grammar model is missing. Add it in Settings under Grammar check.
A model file could not be loaded. Import it again in Settings.
There is no text to check.
This is too long to check. Select a part of it.
Check is off in password and private fields.
The text changed while checking. Press Check again.
This field does not let the keyboard read its text, so it cannot be checked.
Voice typing needs the keyboard keys to be showing. Turn off "show only toolbar" and try again.
Could not check this text. Try a shorter piece.
Could not be loaded. Import it again.
Choose a model file from your storage. The file is copied into the keyboard and checked against the exact reference file; no permission is needed.
This file is not one of the models listed here.
This file is not a valid model.
This file has the wrong size. It may be incomplete.
This is not the exact model file this keyboard uses (its checksum differs). Download it again from the source listed in the README.
There is not enough free storage.
The file could not be read.
Tap the Voice key on the toolbar, speak, then tap Stop. Everything stays on your phone.
Languages: English and Spanish, following the current keyboard language.
Removes fillers and fixes self-corrections, punctuation and numbers.
The English clean-up uses S1-mini by Superwhisper.
Tap the Check key on the toolbar. It checks the selected text, or the whole field, and shows the corrections before anything changes.
Check never reads password fields or private fields.
